scenario_text: A chronic noninfectious condition progresses in stages within a monitored cohort, with individuals advancing from an early asymptomatic stage to a symptomatic stage and eventually to an end-stage. Clinicians track how the number of people in the symptomatic stage changes as inflow from early stage and outflow to end-stage occur. Progression rates between consecutive stages drive the dynamics. Recruitment into the earliest stage is held constant.
